jobs.title: Associate Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
Netradyne harnesses the power of Computer Vision and Edge Computing to revolutionize the modern-day transportation ecosystem. We are a leader in fleet safety solutions. With growth exceeding 4x year over year, our solution is quickly being recognized as a significant disruptive technology. Our team is growing, and we need forward-thinking, uncompromising, competitive team members to continue to facilitate our growth.

Associate Technical Program Manager (Product Development)

Experience: 3 to 6 Years

Summary

As an Associate Technical Program Manager , you will support the end-to-end development of electronic products from concept to launch. Working closely with hardware, firmware, software, mechanical, quality, operations, and sourcing teams, you will help drive program execution, track milestones, manage risks, and ensure successful product delivery within cost, quality, and schedule targets.

Responsibilities

- Support end-to-end product development programs across hardware, software/firmware, and mechanical engineering.

- Track program schedules, milestones, dependencies, risks, and action items.

- Coordinate development phases including prototyping, EVT, DVT, PVT, and production ramp-up.

- Facilitate collaboration between cross-functional teams, suppliers, and manufacturing partners.

- Assist with product integration, validation, certification, and compliance activities.

- Support DFM/DFA/DFT reviews, BOM maturity tracking, and cost optimisation initiatives.

- Monitor program health through dashboards, reports, and stakeholder updates.

- Facilitate Agile ceremonies and milestone reviews to ensure timely execution.

- Identify and escalate risks, dependencies, and execution challenges proactively.

Requirements & Skills

- 3 to 6 years of experience in Technical Program Management, Project Management, or Product Development.

- Exposure to electronic, embedded, IoT, automotive, or hardware product development environments.

- Understanding of hardware, firmware, software, and mechanical development lifecycles.

- Familiarity with EVT, DVT, PVT, prototyping, validation, and product launch processes.

- Experience with Agile/Scrum and project management methodologies.

- Strong stakeholder management, planning, communication, and problem-solving skills.

Desired Qualifications

- B.E./B.Tech in Electrical, Electronics, Mechanical, Computer Science, or related disciplines.

- Experience working on commercial electronic products from development to launch.

- Familiarity with NPI, manufacturing processes, and contract manufacturers.

- Exposure to cloud-connected devices or IoT platforms is an advantage.

- Proficiency in JIRA, Confluence, MS Project, Excel, PowerPoint, Tableau, and SQL.

- PMP, CAPM, Scrum, or Agile certifications are a plus.

- Self-driven with strong ownership and execution mindset.

We are committed to an inclusive and diverse team. Netradyne is an equal-opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status, or any legally protected status.

If there is a match between your experiences/skills and the Company's needs, we will contact you directly.

Netradyne is an equal-opportunity employer.

Applicants only - Recruiting agencies do not contact.

Recruitment Fraud Alert!

There has been an increase in fraud that targets job seekers. Scammers may present themselves to job seekers as Netradyne employees or recruiters. Please be aware that Netradyne does not request sensitive personal data from applicants via text/instant message or any unsecured method; does not promise any advance payment for work equipment set-up and does not use recruitment or job-sourcing agencies that charge candidates an advance fee of any kind. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ‘@netradyne.com’ or ‘@us-greenhouse-mail.io’.

Please review and apply to our available job openings at Netradyne.com/company/careers. For more information on avoiding and reporting scams, please visit the Federal Trade Commission's job scams website .

jobs.title: Product Manager - Integrations
jobs.location: Nashville, Tennessee, United States; San Diego, California, United States; San Francisco, California, United States
jobs.description:
Netradyne harnesses the power of Computer Vision and Edge Computing to revolutionize the modern-day transportation ecosystem. We are a leader in fleet safety solutions. With growth exceeding 4x year over year, our solution is quickly being recognized as a significant disruptive technology. Our team is growing, and we need forward-thinking, uncompromising, competitive team members to continue to facilitate our growth.

Overview

Netradyne is seeking an Integrations Product Manager to own the definition, delivery, and adoption of integrations between the Driver•i platform and third-party systems.

The successful candidate will work directly with customers, resellers, partners, and internal stakeholders to understand business processes, identify opportunities, and define scalable solutions. They must be able to independently analyze workflows, design integration approaches, evaluate solution alternatives, and document requirements before engineering implementation begins. Once initiatives move into development, they will drive cross-functional execution and collaborate with Engineering, Customer Success, Sales, and Operations to ensure successful delivery and adoption.

The ideal candidate combines strong product management skills with technical aptitude, business analysis, and program leadership. They are comfortable working with APIs and integrations, managing multiple concurrent initiatives, and turning recurring operational work into scalable product capabilities.

Responsibilities

·       Define integration requirements between Driver•i and third-party platforms such as ELDs, TMS, fleet management, routing, dispatch, and other enterprise systems.

·       Work directly with customers, partners, and resellers to understand workflows, business requirements, and integration opportunities.

·       Independently create workflow diagrams, process flows, requirements, and solution proposals prior to engineering implementation.

·       Evaluate multiple solution approaches and recommend the best option based on customer value, scalability, technical feasibility, and long-term platform strategy.

·       Drive product initiatives from discovery through launch, including requirements, prioritization, stakeholder alignment, testing, rollout, and adoption.

·       Coordinate with customers, partners, and internal teams to proactively identify and resolve blockers throughout delivery.

·       Identify opportunities to automate, standardize, or productize recurring operational activities.

·       Contribute to roadmap planning through customer feedback, market insights, and business objectives.

·       Perform light technical analysis, API validation, scripting, querying, or troubleshooting where appropriate.

Requirements

·       3+ years of experience in Product Management, Technical Product Management, Business Analysis, Solutions Engineering, or a related discipline.

·       Experience defining workflows, requirements, and solution designs for software products or integrations.

·       Demonstrated ability to independently analyze business problems and develop solution approaches prior to engineering involvement.

·       Experience working directly with customers, partners, vendors, or resellers.

·       Familiarity with APIs, webhooks, SaaS platforms, authentication concepts, and integration architectures.

·       Strong communication, analytical, and organizational skills.

·       Ability to manage multiple concurrent initiatives in a fast-paced environment.

·       Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

Preferred Qualifications

·       Experience with API platforms, integrations, or enterprise SaaS products.

·       Familiarity with OAuth2, SSO, SDKs, database concepts, and cloud technologies.

·       Experience using Postman, SQL, scripting tools, or similar technical validation tools.

·       Experience in fleet management, logistics, transportation, or telematics.

Education:

- Bachelor's degree required

*Hybrid Work Schedule:

We believe in the value of in-person collaboration while maintaining flexibility. Team members work from the office on  Monday, Wednesday, and Thursday , with remote work on  Tuesday and Friday .

Technical Product Manager - Integrations

Overview:

Netradyne is looking for a motivated individual to join our Product Management team as a Technical Product Manager - Integrations. This position will define integration requirements with partners, customers, and resellers while enhancing the value of Netradyne's platform and ecosystem. They will conduct business analysis, lead scope preparation, understand technical requirements, interact with customers and vendors, collaborate in the development of training materials for other departments, and support those departments when promoting and selling integration services.

The ideal candidate combines strong product management skills with technical aptitude and curiosity. They are detail-oriented, proactive, well organized, possess excellent communication skills, and have a passion for excellence, innovation, and customer success.

Responsibilities:

- Define integration scope of Netradyne systems and data with third-party software platforms, including ELD, routing, maintenance, fuel, telematics, and other enterprise systems, with the goal of enhancing value for all stakeholders.

- Design and document integration workflows, business processes, data exchanges, and user experiences across Netradyne and third-party platforms.

- Establish relationships with Netradyne teams, customers, partners, and vendors to effectively build and expand a comprehensive integration platform.

- Partner closely with engineering teams to define requirements, evaluate technical approaches, and drive successful delivery of integration capabilities.

3+ years of experience in Product Management, Technical Product Management, or Program Management roles, preferably involving API platforms, integrations, or enterprise software.

Demonstrated ability to define technical requirements, design integration workflows, and effectively partner with engineering teams to deliver scalable solutions.

Strong technical aptitude with the ability to understand APIs, authentication frameworks, data flows, and system integrations.

- Ability to understand technical requirements and effectively communicate with engineering teams, customers, and partners.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to identify issues, investigate root causes, and work with cross-functional teams to resolve them.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

- Strong organizational and program management skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously.
